name: activation-check-review
intent: [goal:G-ecosystem] Report in at most 240 words how activation.rs decides whether an installed binary is skipped before exec, with exact quotations from the pinned source.

substance.statement: The report states how Candidate::read computes the build hash and rejects an identity receipt whose build does not match the executable.
The report names both skip reasons returned by skip_reason and the condition for each.
The report states what makes a running commit count as clean for the same_revision comparison.
